objective: Screen a hybrid that combines projected-address-bound recurrent writes with a trainable addressed/global RWKV mixture-of-experts controller and projected-only abstention.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: Address-bound stable readout strongly separated correct from zero recurrence by 0.934338 mean CE but failed donor and layer-permuted specificity at -0.008722 and -0.000784.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Preserve the verified write-address binding and add a learned query-conditioned choice among addressed recurrence, global recurrence, and projected-only abstention.

architecture.write_binding: The projected proposal selects one slot; every valid recurrent RWKV token update from that write episode is scanned into that slot.
architecture.read_addressing: The projected query route selects the corresponding recurrent slot for the addressed expert.
architecture.gate: three-way query-conditioned softmax over normalized query, addressed read, and global read
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero addressed and global recurrence is exactly projected-only.
architecture.projected_carrier: Projected keys and values remain the fixed material carrier under recurrent interventions.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked supervised causal training run with a fresh source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and redesign the controller or writer.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, the unused strength holdout, or native generation.
